title: Token2025
tagline: Decentralized event financing with compliant RWA tokens, ENS identity, and investor protection.
description:
Token2025 is a protocol and product for tokenizing live events (concerts, sports seasons, festivals) so promoters can raise capital by selling compliant, revenue-share tokens to verified investors. The system is designed to work as an MVP on an EVM chain using ETH. 

Core value proposition: 

1) Access & Liquidity — opens event investing to retail/global investors by tokenizing future revenue.
2) Compliance — permissioned tokens (ERC-3643 style) ensure only verified participants hold tokens.
3) Risk mitigation — shared insurance pool reduces downside for small investors.
4) Automation — smart contracts mediate fundraising, payouts, and insurance claims.


Token Economics:

area — total number of shares (integer).
req_amount — fundraising target 
pricePerToken = req_amount / area.
INSURANCE_BP — insurance fee percentage goes to the common pool
promoterShare — unsold tokens remain with Project/promoter; promoter receives net raise after insurance cut at close.

Revenue share distributions use token balances as the weighting.
how_its_made:
💻 Technology Stack
Smart Contracts: Solidity, OpenZeppelin, ERC-3643, Integra
Identity: ENS subdomains + Verifiable Credentials
Frontend: Next.js, Ethers.js

ENS: Human-Readable Identities & Asset Registry
1) Give names to wallet addresses
2) As is the vision of ENS , we give contracts and tokens names
           eg: iicc.NewDelhi.eth
Format is <event>.<location>.eth
which makes the contracts quite intuitive hence improving th UX exponentially

Integra:
1) We follow the ERC-3643
2) We developed 3 extra ideas over real estates as Integra visioned

Insurance Pool:
1) to mitigate the risks we have implemented a common insurance pool
2) each event contributes 5% of their investment to the pool
3) later in case of loss , investors are compensated using this pool hence cushioning the impact
